decisions.stem: A junior doctor reviewing a 15-year-old with recurrent headaches says he has covered **Home, Education, Activities, Drugs, Sexuality, and mood**. According to the notes, which additional group of issues should still be included in the adolescent assessment?

A 14-year-old spends much of the consultation talking about **who she is becoming**, wanting more independence, and struggling to manage intense changing feelings. Which developmental domain is **most directly represented** in the notes?

A 15-year-old says, "There is no point trying to improve things at school because whether things go badly or well is just luck." Which clinician response best supports the **resilience factor** highlighted in the notes?
A 13-year-old says vaping and weekend drinking with friends are harmless because "the brain is already grown by secondary school". Which reply is **most consistent** with the notes?
